SUBRAMANIAM ROAD, OPP.') reports 'Total Shipments 228 Records detected', 'Trading Partners 7', 'Ports 12', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-23'. DUBAI UAE' (30 shipments). Source counter: page claims 228 total shipments; only 5 individual rows were visible in the free view (3 exports, 2 imports), so 223 rows unverified.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS code exist for Tanzania (2026-02-23, BOL 9917520), Uzbekistan (2025-12-05, BOL 7612577) and UAE buyers, all under HS 84219900 (parts of filtering/purifying machinery) rather than the declared 842121 — the declared HS should be corrected to the actual 84219900 per Rule 3, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Note the company is a mixed importer/exporter: it imports RO membranes and UF modules from Hydranautics/Nitto, X-Flow BV, LG Chem, NANOH2O (e.g. 2026-01-03 'NANOH2O CO., LTD. -> FILTRA ... RO MEMBRANE LG SW 400 GR -70 PCS', BOL 6691366) and re-exports assemblies, i.e. role is closer to manufacturer_trader than pure manufacturer. Domestic supply evidence could NOT be verified: web_search was unavailable (connection refused) throughout, and thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com, eximpedia.app and tenderdetail.com all returned 403/522, so no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or annual-report domestic split was retrieved — recorded as null/unknown, not as 'none_found'. The 'LTD' slug variant on ImportKey returned an empty record set, so the 'LIMITED' slug is the correct entity match. No revenue or export value figures were public in the free view, so they are left null rather than estimated.
